cover_letter_text:
Hello,

I am applying for the Civil Engineering Draftsperson role at Western Grammar School, advertised on SEEK. Your advert names the school's developments so far: additional classrooms, underground parking, a multipurpose hall and land acquired for future campus expansion.

I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026. In it I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities. I have also worked on a hall project on site. In the Philippines in 2019 I helped deliver a community hall renovation, finished within its six month construction program, where I reviewed the structural and architectural drawings and checked work against project requirements. On my next project there I coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Sydney for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a full Victorian driver's licence and a White Card. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Marc Masarate

questions.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
questions.answer: The option that names a graduate temporary work visa (Subclass 485). If the list has no such option, choose the temporary visa option that has no restriction on hours or industry.

questions.question: How many years' experience do you have as a civil drafter?
questions.answer: Choose the lowest option (no paid drafting role). Free text if offered: 'No paid drafting role. Prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D in the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design (February 2024 to February 2026).' Never write 'two years of drafting': the diploma ran two years but drafting was part of it.
